content_data.main_message: Excited to share insights from our latest paper on human-robot interaction in advanced manufacturing! Our findings highlight key considerations for seamless integration of collaborative robotics in European industrial settings. We're exploring how adaptive interfaces can boost efficiency and safety. #Robotics #HRI #AdvancedManufacturing #Industry40 #EuropeanInnovation
